description: Ministry of Public Services, Provincial Councils and Local Government - 6 th Amendment of Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Planning Service
categorisation: This gazette contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, detailing recruitment procedures, examination syllabi, and promotion requirements. The content specifically addresses public service recruitment, examination processes, and service conditions, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government structure/personnel changes.
